guideText: What to know before requesting a quote Machin Solutions designs, builds and installs thatched tiki huts and chickee huts for outdoor spaces. Based in Homestead, the business serves Miami-Dade, Broward and the Upper Keys. Project location, intended use and site conditions determine the scope of each proposal. What determines the price? A quote depends on dimensions, unsupported spans, height, materials, roof design, access and footing conditions. Natural or synthetic thatch and the condition of an existing structure need to be clarified before comparing proposals. We do not publish a square-foot rate: there is no verified price list for these custom projects. How should you compare proposals and schedules? Compare proposals with the same dimensions, materials, roof, footings, finishes and included work. Ask for written confirmation of who handles permits and electrical work, exclusions and warranty terms. Request a schedule that separates design, approvals, materials and installation; this site does not publish a confirmed standard lead time.  What to confirm for a tiki hut Before hiring, request photographs of completed tiki huts, the proposed material and its maintenance requirements. The photographs currently available on this site show pergolas and other outdoor structures. Confirm directly whether repair or re-thatching of an existing hut is available. Planning tiki hut construction  How to start your enquiry Prepare the project city, photos of the space, rough dimensions, roof preference and intended use.
